headline: Maharashtra GST officials search Sudarshan Chemical offices
summary: Maharashtra GST officials conducted a search at Sudarshan Chemical Industries' offices and manufacturing units under Section 67 of GST law.

headline: Sedemac Mechatronics hits record quarterly ECU sales
summary: Sedemac Mechatronics reported its highest ever quarterly sales of control-intensive ECUs at 1,452,867 units, up 37.5% YoY, while cumulative ISG+EFI ECU sales crossed 1 million units.

headline: Stocks in News: Bajaj HFL, Sudarshan Chem, Redington in focus
summary: Bajaj Housing Finance rallies on strong AUM growth while Sudarshan Chemical jumps despite GST searches. Redington slips after signing a cyber-security distribution deal.

headline: RBL Bank Q2FY27: Deposits up 34%, advances jump 40%
summary: RBL Bank reports provisional Q2FY27 metrics showing total deposits at ₹1,562.8 billion (+34% YoY) and gross advances at ₹1,433.5 billion (+40% YoY). CASA ratio dips to 27.2%.

headline: Finz Finance to transfer ₹95.79 crore loan portfolio
summary: PhysicsWallah's wholly owned subsidiary Finz Finance plans to transfer its ₹95.79 crore loan portfolio and scale back its lending activities.

headline: Sammaan Capital Q2FY27: Disbursements hit ₹6,000 crore
summary: Sammaan Capital reported Q2FY27 disbursements of ₹6,000 crore, up from ₹3,875 crore in Q1. AUM crossed ₹59,000 crore as new customer additions surged to 30,700.

headline: Lords Mark secures MHRA registration for IVD portfolio
summary: Lords Mark Industries Limited received MHRA registration for its IVD portfolio in the UK. Commercial sales are scheduled to begin in December 2026, two months ahead of the original schedule.

headline: Marico Q2FY27 Update: Volume Growth & Margin Tailwinds
summary: Marico reports strong Q2FY27 performance with double-digit volume growth in India and teens growth internationally. Operating profit is expected to rise mid-twenties on copra price tailwinds.

headline: Indian rupee opens stronger at 96.2150 vs dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 96.2150 against the US dollar, strengthening from the previous close of 96.3150, reflecting a marginal gain in the domestic currency.

headline: Embassy Developments books ₹1,800 cr in pre-sales
summary: Embassy Developments Ltd recorded ₹1,800 crore in pre-sales at the launch of Embassy Origins. The project achieved 62% absorption with 477 homes booked within a week.

headline: Employers may get GST credit on group insurance
summary: Employers could soon claim input tax credit on GST paid for group health and life insurance premiums, potentially reducing costs for businesses offering employee benefits.

headline: India FMCG value growth hits 6-quarter high at 8.6%
summary: India's FMCG sector logged value growth of 8.6% in Q2FY27, a 6-quarter high, with rural growth at 10.6% and urban demand rebounding sharply, per the article.

headline: Deepwater gas ceiling price raised to $9.89/MMBtu
summary: The government has raised the deepwater natural gas ceiling price to $9.89/MMBtu for six months, boosting realisations for producers including Reliance Industries and BP's KG-D6 block.

headline: SAIL and NMDC to scout overseas ore and coal assets
summary: The government has asked Steel Authority of India and NMDC to identify overseas iron ore and coking coal assets to secure long-term raw material supplies and reduce steelmaking costs.

headline: Appliance makers eye festive-season sales growth
summary: Consumer durables and electronics makers expect festive-season sales growth despite price hikes, banking on strong consumer demand and replacement purchases.

headline: FSSAI orders Everest to recall unsafe cumin powder
summary: FSSAI has directed Everest to recall its cumin powder after quality tests flagged non-compliance, intensifying regulatory scrutiny on packaged spice manufacturers.

headline: Half a dozen compact hybrids set to enter India
summary: Around half a dozen small hybrid models are preparing to enter India over the next two years as automakers respond to stricter CAFE-III emission norms.

headline: Reliance Retail and 7-Eleven end India franchise tie-up
summary: Reliance Retail and 7-Eleven have ended their five-year India franchise partnership, with convenience stores facing profitability challenges amid quick-commerce and kirana competition.

headline: GST 2.0 to ease compliance and unlock tax credits
summary: GST 2.0 proposals aim to simplify compliance, extend input tax credits to plant and machinery, accelerate refunds, and reduce disputes over small-value tax matters.
